title: A CO Survey of SpARCS Star-forming Brightest Cluster Galaxies: Evidence for Uniformity in BCG Molecular Gas Processing across Cosmic Time

recipe.goal: calibrate and image the CO cubes
recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration in CASA, then minimally cleaned natural-weighted cubes, continuum-subtracted and primary-beam corrected
key_parameters: pixel size 0.2 to 0.4 arcsec; spectral resolution chosen per source from detection strength

recipe.method: Extract spectrum from an elliptical aperture at the BCG centre, twice the synthesized beam axes and with the same orientation

recipe.goal: build Moment-0 map and fit its spatial extent
recipe.method: Collapse cube over channels with significant emission from the first Gaussian fit, then fit a 2D elliptical Gaussian
key_parameters: channels kept within 2 sigma of the mean of the Gaussian fit

recipe.goal: extract final spectra, fit line flux and derive gas masses
recipe.method: Second-pass spectrum from an elliptical aperture with axes three times the 2D Gaussian FWHM, fit with single or double Gaussian; line flux converted to CO luminosity and gas mass
key_parameters: aperture axes = 3 x Gaussian FWHM; line flux = area under the fit

recipe.goal: stack and set limits for non-detections
recipe.method: Stack spectra of the 6 non-detections centred on OzDES redshifts; upper limits from collapsing cubes over the mean detected FWHM and taking the 3 sigma RMS
key_parameters: collapse bandwidth = 356 km/s (mean FWHM of detected peaks)

recipe.method: Stellar mass from IRAC 3.6 um rest-frame K-band luminosity with a template K-correction and a calibrated mass-to-light ratio; SFR from MIPS 24 um luminosity using Kennicutt (1998) eq. 4
key_parameters: mass-to-light ratio 0.83; stellar mass uncertainty 0.3 dex; SFR uncertainty 0.15 dex
assumptions: 11 Gyr simple stellar population, solar metallicity, Salpeter IMF

recipe.goal: build a homogeneous low-z comparison sample and remove AGN
recipe.method: Recompute stellar masses and SFRs for the Edge BCGs with the same methods; flag AGN with the Donley IRAC wedge and exclude them from the analysis
key_parameters: Donley AGN wedge criteria applied to IRAC colours

recipe.goal: compare the Mgas-sSFR correlation of the two BCG samples
recipe.method: Fit a straight line to each sample separately in log space with orthogonal distance regression, restricted to the BCGs with z<0.6 for the main comparison
